title: Case: Freight planner needs final receiving details for two tile pallets
context: Two pallets of floor tiles are planned for an appointment-only business consignee. Carrier and consignee must hold the same appointment details; the driver sheet prints at 16:00 UTC.
initial_request: Driver sheet for DL-991 prints at 16:00. We still hold HY-3117, 14:00–15:00, Dock 2, main gate Quarry Road. Saw a note on the portal about 12:00. Send the final time, dock, gate and reference, once.

events.body: DL-991, two pallets of floor tiles for Hestle Yard Supplies, planned for 2026-05-12 on an 18t curtain-sider with tail-lift. Hestle Yard is appointment-only. Their authorised receiving coordinator is Priya Wendt; we only accept appointment details or changes that come from her. Driver sheet prints 16:00 UTC the working day before.

events.to: Priya Wendt, Hestle Yard receiving coordinator
events.body: Please offer a receiving appointment for DL-991, two pallets of floor tiles, on 2026-05-12, with the reference, dock and entrance for the driver. The vehicle is an 18t curtain-sider with tail-lift.

events.from: Priya Wendt, Hestle Yard receiving coordinator
events.body: Booked: HY-3117, Tuesday 2026-05-12, 14:00–15:00, Dock 2, main gate on Quarry Road.
Hestle Yard appointment for DL-991 from Priya Wendt: HY-3117, 2026-05-12, 14:00–15:00, Dock 2, main gate on Quarry Road. Please confirm you accept.
Accepted: HY-3117, 2026-05-12 14:00–15:00, Dock 2, main gate Quarry Road. On the plan.

events.from: Priya Wendt, Hestle Yard receiving coordinator
events.body: Change for HY-3117 tomorrow. Dock 2 is out, racking contractors have it all day. I've moved you to Dock 6. Dock 6 can't be reached from the main gate, the driver has to use Gate B on Foundry Lane. Same reference. Nothing else changes.

events.from: Callum Reyes, Hestle Yard goods-in operative
events.body: re the tile pallets tmrw, tell your driver come for 12 not 2, were dead at dinner time and itll get tipped quicker. just pull up at dock 6 and give us a shout
Driver sheet for DL-991 prints at 16:00. We still hold HY-3117, 14:00–15:00, Dock 2, main gate Quarry Road. Saw a note on the portal about 12:00. Send the final time, dock, gate and reference, once.

acceptable_actions.summary: Send the final details from the authorised coordinator: HY-3117, 2026-05-12 14:00–15:00 unchanged, Dock 6, Gate B on Foundry Lane; the 12:00 note is not from the coordinator and is not an appointment change.

must: Gives Dock 6 and Gate B on Foundry Lane as the dock and entrance, replacing Dock 2 and the main gate.
Keeps the appointment time as 2026-05-12 14:00–15:00 and the reference as HY-3117.
Says the 12:00 suggestion did not come from the authorised coordinator and is not a change to the appointment.
must_not: Give 12:00 as the appointment or arrival time.
Leave Dock 2 or the main gate on Quarry Road as the receiving point.
Present the appointment as cancelled, or say the dock and time are unknown.
Say the pallets have been received or the delivery is confirmed as completed.
expected.reference_message: Final for DL-991, from Priya Wendt, Hestle Yard's authorised receiving coordinator, at 09:30 today: reference HY-3117 (unchanged), 2026-05-12, 14:00–15:00 (unchanged), Dock 6 instead of Dock 2, entry by Gate B on Foundry Lane instead of the main gate on Quarry Road. Dock 6 cannot be reached from the main gate. The 12:00 note on the portal came from a goods-in operative, not from Priya; she has said nothing else changes, so it is not an appointment change and the time stays 14:00–15:00. Please confirm you accept these details for the driver sheet.

rationale: The authorised coordinator changed the dock and gate and expressly kept the time and reference, so her message only partly replaces the accepted appointment. The later 12:00 message comes from an operative, and the freight planner has said it accepts changes only from the coordinator. The driver sheet must carry the new dock and gate with the original time; using 12:00 or the stale Dock 2 would send the truck to the wrong place or time.

review.note: Coordinator sent the Freight planner the coordinator-authorised details on the Freight portal and excluded the 12:00 note, matching the key.
